metadata.title: Implement Step Execution and Action Handling

story.iWant: the environment to execute agent actions and advance episode state
story.soThat: agents can interact with the temporal function and accumulate rewards
story.tasks:
- Implement action validation (AC: #1) - Check if action is in [0, 1, 2] - Raise ValueError with clear message if invalid - Use exact error message format from Architecture specification - Add type hint: action: int
- Implement position update logic (AC: #2) - Import ACTION_LEFT, ACTION_STAY, ACTION_RIGHT from agent module - Implement conditional logic for each action type: - ACTION_LEFT (0): self.state['position'] -= self.step_size - ACTION_STAY (1): position unchanged (no operation) - ACTION_RIGHT (2): self.state['position'] += self.step_size - Apply np.clip to clamp position to self.function.bounds - Ensure position remains float64 type
- Implement reward calculation (AC: #3) - Call self.function.evaluate() at new position and self.state['timestep'] - Extract scalar reward value from result (handle array return) - Ensure reward is float (float64) - Increment self.state['cumulative_reward'] by step reward - Maintain float64 precision for cumulative_reward
- Implement timestep advancement and done flag (AC: #4) - Increment self.state['timestep'] by 1 - Calculate done = (self.state['timestep'] >= self.episode_length) - Ensure done is boolean type
- Generate observation and build info dict (AC: #5, #6) - Call self._get_observation() to generate observation dict - Build info dict with cumulative_reward and perfect_score - Get perfect_score from self.function.get_perfect_score(self.episode_length) - Ensure info dict keys match specification exactly
- Return 4-tuple in correct order (AC: #5) - Return (observation, reward, done, info) - Add type hint: -> tuple[dict, float, bool, dict] - Verify return signature matches Architecture specification
- Add NumPy-style docstring (AC: #7, Architecture requirement) - Short one-line summary - Detailed description of behavior - Parameters section documenting action parameter - Returns section documenting 4-tuple elements - Raises section documenting ValueError for invalid action - Examples section showing usage
- Validate performance requirements (AC: #8) - Profile step() execution time using timeit - Ensure < 10ms per step call (including observation generation) - Verify no unnecessary object creation or copying
- Update and create tests (AC: #1-8) - Add test_step_action_validation to verify ValueError raised - Add test_step_action_left to verify position decrease - Add test_step_action_stay to verify position unchanged - Add test_step_action_right to verify position increase - Add test_step_position_clamping to verify bounds enforcement - Add test_step_reward_calculation to verify reward at new position - Add test_step_cumulative_reward to verify accumulation - Add test_step_timestep_advancement to verify increment - Add test_step_done_flag to verify done = True at episode end - Add test_step_return_signature to verify 4-tuple structure - Add test_step_info_dict_structure to verify keys - Add test_step_performance to verify < 10ms execution - Run all tests and ensure they pass

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
AC1: Action Validation - Validates action is 0, 1, or 2 - Raises ValueError for invalid actions - Error message: "Invalid action {action}. Must be 0 (left), 1 (stay), or 2 (right)"
AC2: Position Update - ACTION_LEFT (0): position decreases by step_size - ACTION_STAY (1): position unchanged - ACTION_RIGHT (2): position increases by step_size - Position clamped to function.bounds using np.clip
AC3: Reward Calculation - Evaluates function at new position and current timestep - Returns scalar float reward value - Increments cumulative_reward by step reward - Uses float64 precision
AC4: Timestep Advancement - Increments timestep by 1 after action execution - done flag = True when timestep >= episode_length - done flag = False otherwise
AC5: Return Signature - step() returns 4-tuple: (observation, reward, done, info) - observation: dict from _get_observation() with updated state - reward: float (step reward value) - done: bool (episode completion flag) - info: dict with cumulative_reward and perfect_score keys
AC6: Info Dictionary - Contains 'cumulative_reward': float (running total) - Contains 'perfect_score': float (from function.get_perfect_score(episode_length))
AC7: State Atomicity - All state updates are atomic (happen within step() method)
AC8: Performance - step() completes in < 10ms (including observation generation)

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Environment & Agent Execution
doc.snippet: Validates action is 0, 1, or 2 (raises ValueError otherwise). Position updates: LEFT decreases, STAY unchanged, RIGHT increases by step_size. Position clamped to function bounds using np.clip. Reward calculated at new position and current timestep. Returns 4-tuple: (observation, reward, done, info). done=True when timestep >= episode_length.

doc.title: FuncBench Architecture
doc.snippet: step() must return 4-tuple: (observation, reward, done, info). Gym-like API pattern per ADR-004. Action validation with specific ValueError message format. State updates must be atomic. Type hints required for all method signatures.

doc.title: FuncBench Architecture
doc.snippet: ALWAYS use these integer codes: ACTION_LEFT = 0, ACTION_STAY = 1, ACTION_RIGHT = 2. Action space uses exact integer codes from Architecture specification.

doc.title: Story 2.3 Completion
doc.snippet: Environment state dict available: position (float64), timestep (int), cumulative_reward (float64), history (list). _get_observation() fully implemented (lines 182-265). Use self.function.evaluate() for reward calculation. Use self.function.bounds for np.clip. Float64 precision pattern established.

python.package: Numerical computation, float64 precision, np.clip for bounds enforcement, vectorized function evaluation

story-context.constraints: - step() must return exactly 4 values in this order: (observation, reward, done, info) - Action validation error message MUST use exact format: "Invalid action {action}. Must be 0 (left), 1 (stay), or 2 (right)" - All state updates (position, cumulative_reward, timestep) must happen atomically within step() method - Position must be clamped using np.clip(position, bounds[0], bounds[1]) - Reward must be extracted as scalar float from function.evaluate() array return - Float64 precision must be maintained for cumulative_reward - info dict must be JSON-serializable (use float() conversion for numpy types) - Must call _get_observation() AFTER state updates to get current observation - done flag must be boolean type (timestep >= episode_length) - No state copying or unnecessary object creation (performance requirement) - Import ACTION_LEFT, ACTION_STAY, ACTION_RIGHT from funcbench.agent module - NumPy-style docstring with Parameters, Returns, Raises, and Examples sections required

tests.standards: - Use pytest framework with fixtures from conftest.py - Test file: tests/test_environment.py (add new test functions) - Use gaussian_function fixture for Function2D instance - Follow existing test patterns from Stories 2.2-2.3 - Test both happy path and error cases (invalid actions) - Verify all return types and dict structures - Use timeit or pytest-benchmark for performance validation - Ensure deterministic tests (no random behavior without seeds) - All tests must pass before story completion
tests.ideas: - test_step_action_validation: Verify ValueError raised for actions not in [0, 1, 2] - test_step_action_left: Create env at position 10, take ACTION_LEFT, verify position decreases by step_size - test_step_action_stay: Take ACTION_STAY, verify position unchanged - test_step_action_right: Take ACTION_RIGHT, verify position increases by step_size - test_step_position_clamping_left_bound: Position at left bound, take ACTION_LEFT, verify stays at bound - test_step_position_clamping_right_bound: Position at right bound, take ACTION_RIGHT, verify stays at bound - test_step_reward_calculation: Verify reward matches function.evaluate() at new position - test_step_cumulative_reward: Take multiple steps, verify cumulative_reward = sum of step rewards - test_step_timestep_advancement: Take step, verify timestep incremented by 1 - test_step_done_flag_false: Early in episode, verify done = False - test_step_done_flag_true: At episode_length, verify done = True - test_step_return_signature: Verify step returns 4-tuple with correct types (dict, float, bool, dict) - test_step_observation_updated: Verify observation reflects new state after step - test_step_info_dict_structure: Verify info has 'cumulative_reward' and 'perfect_score' keys - test_step_performance: Use timeit to verify step() completes in < 10ms - test_step_sequence: Take multiple steps with different actions, verify state consistency
